# TheStage Android SDK — agent index
# On-device inference for Android on Qualcomm Snapdragon (QNN HTP NPU,
# with GPU / CPU fallback). Source of truth for customer docs: docs/*.md

## Init (required)
- Kotlin: TheStageAI.registerContext(context); TheStageAI.initialize(api_token = "...")   // suspend
- Flutter: TheStageFlutterSDK.initialize(api_token: '...')
- Seat: (apiToken, deviceId) — see licensing.md / product_terms.md
- Pricing: Service Request at https://app.thestage.ai/contact — no public rate card

## Imports
- Kotlin core: import ai.thestage.qlip.TheStageAI      // object (singleton)
- Flutter: package:thestage_android_sdk/thestage_android_sdk.dart
  → class TheStageFlutterSDK

## Flutter surface (TheStageFlutterSDK, snake_case)
- start_model / stop_model / infer / infer_stream
- open_tts_streamer / send / finish_stream / stop_stream
- prefetch_model / on_progress (single global load-progress stream)
- ensureDeveloperLogs (mirrors SDK log ring into `flutter run` in debug)

## Kotlin core symbols
- TheStageAI (object): start_model, stop_model, infer, infer_stream,
  open_tts_streamer, prefetch_model, recent_logs, set_log_listener,
  record_log, record_error, last_error / last_error_code
- TheStageLLM                          // Qwen3 / LFM2.5 chat
- WhisperModel                         // ASR
- TheStageVLM                          // VLM: image + prompt -> text (lfm2-vl)
- NeuTTSMultilingual, NeuTTS           // TTS: 9-lang multilingual, English nano
- SileroVAD                            // stateful VAD
- TheStageVoiceAgent, TheStageAgentConfig   // full voice agent
- SpeakerId                            // model_type "speaker-id" (redimnet2)
- SamplingParams                       // per-call LLM sampling overrides

## Pages
- README.md — index, quick start, audio contract, model cache
- llm.md — TheStageLLM chat + streaming + sampling (incl. min_new_tokens)
- whisper.md — WhisperModel ASR
- vlm.md — TheStageVLM (image + prompt -> text, LFM2.5-VL)
- tts.md — NeuTTS + NeuTTSMultilingual
- vad.md — SileroVAD
- streaming.md — TTS / LLM stream contracts, back-pressure
- voice_agent.md — full agent (VAD→STT→LLM→TTS, smart-turn, barge-in,
  auto_listen / beginListening, sendRequest, custom nodes, device integrity)
- model_management.md — availability, prefetch, load/unload, memory
- ai_packs.md — ship models via Google Play AI packs (aipack:// engines source)
- speaker_embedding.md — speaker-id enroll / cosine verify (CPU)
- licensing.md — (apiToken, deviceId) seat, reinstall, online-validation behavior
- product_terms.md — commercial terms summary (pricing = Service Request)
- logging.md — diagnostics ring, session log file, `logs` EventChannel

## Audio rates (PCM float, mono, samples in [-1, 1])
- VAD / Whisper / speaker embedding input: 16 kHz mono Float
- VAD frame: 512 samples (32 ms)
- TTS output (NeuTTS / NeuTTSMultilingual): 24 kHz mono Float
- Speaker embedding window: 2.0 s (32 000 samples), output 192-d L2-norm

## Compute
- Heavy graphs (Whisper encoder/decoder, TTS LLM) default to the
  Snapdragon NPU (Hexagon HTP via QNN); GPU / CPU are fallbacks
- Small stateful models (Silero VAD, smart-turn, speaker-id) run on ORT-CPU
- Kotlin audio buffers: FloatArray; Flutter: Float32List (never Float64List)
